hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); git pull --rebase origin "$branch" 2>/dev/null || git pull --rebase origin main; git push -u origin "$branch"

changed=$(git diff HEAD~1 --name-only 2>/dev/null); msg=""; if echo "$changed" | grep -qE '^(agents/|\.github/workflows/|utils/)'; then msg="SYSTEM_DOCS.md + CLAUDE.md REMINDER: code changed under agents/, utils/ or .github/workflows/ - update SYSTEM_DOCS.md and CLAUDE.md if this changed architecture, agent behaviour, rules, thresholds or secrets. "; fi; if echo "$changed" | grep -qE '^(agents/|utils/|CLAUDE\.md|\.claude/)'; then msg="$msg MEMORY REMINDER: record anything learned this session under docs/memory/ (CLAUDE.md rule 5), and mark the BACKLOG.md row with the commit hash."; fi; if [ -n "$msg" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "%s"}}' "$msg"; fi
